labels.name: Fixed drug eruption
labels.function: Recurs at the same site with each re-exposure to the culprit

labels.name: Lichen planus
labels.function: Purple pruritic polygonal papules; linked to hepatitis C

labels.name: Simple drug eruption
labels.function: Morbilliform rash days after a new medication; face spared

labels.name: Lichen sclerosus et atrophicus
labels.function: Hypopigmented, thinned vulvar plaques in postmenopausal women

labels.name: Lichen striatus
labels.function: Single line of papules in a child; resolves in about a year

labels.name: Granuloma annulare
labels.function: Non-scaly ring-shaped plaques with firm borders

labels.name: Pityriasis rosea
labels.function: Oval patches along skin tension lines after a herald patch
